about_founder_advantage_p1: As an outstanding overseas Chinese leader and business figure spanning Shandong and Hong Kong, Mr. Jin Hui has accumulated over a decade of deep expertise in the digital transformation of the education industry and cross-border capital operations. He possesses both a keen international vision and full-chain resources from top-level government design to grassroots business implementation.
about_founder_advantage_p2: Taking "AI + Cross-border" as his strategic pivot, Mr. Jin Hui personally leads the Lugang Connect project, transforming his rich Shandong–Hong Kong political and business network into the platform's core competitiveness — providing forward-looking strategic guidance and strong resource endorsement for compliant global expansion, cross-border financing and talent recruitment.

about_hero_commit: Lugang Connect is committed to becoming:
about_hero_p1: Independently developed by Hong Kong Shuogu Guanghe Culture Communication Co., Ltd., leveraging industry-leading large model technology to build a digital bridge connecting the land of Qilu with the world.
about_hero_p2: We thoroughly implement the national strategy of "high-level opening-up" and actively respond to the Shandong Provincial Government's calls to "build a new highland of opening-up" and "attract investment and talent".
about_hero_slogan: —— Bridging Two-way Resources between Shandong and Hong Kong · Empowering High-Level Opening-Up ——
about_history_highlight: We are not only a "converter" of policy dividends, but also a "digital pioneer" of Shandong–Hong Kong integration in the new era.
about_history_p1: Amid the deep implementation of the national "14th Five-Year Plan" and the comprehensive deepening of Shandong–Hong Kong cooperation, the Lugang Connect Cross-border AI Platform was officially founded in Hong Kong.
about_history_p2: Built upon central policies benefiting Hong Kong, Shandong's "attract investment and talent" strategy and the HKSAR Government's cross-border facilitation measures, the platform is rooted in Hong Kong — an international hub of tech innovation and finance — aiming to break geographic barriers with large AI models and build new digital infrastructure connecting trade, talent and data across Shandong and Hong Kong.
about_history_year: 2025: Born of the Times, Connecting the Future with Intelligence
about_mission_card: 🎉 Enterprises, experts, scholars and aspiring youth are cordially invited to register and join us
about_mission_p1: Lugang Connect is not merely a service platform — it is a political mission and a social responsibility.
about_mission_p2: To amplify government trade influence through digital means, and to solve users' core pain points with professional services.
about_mission_title1: Riding the Wind of Shandong–Hong Kong Cooperation
about_mission_title2: Writing a New Chapter of Openness and Prosperity
about_north_card1_text: Powered by AI and big data, we deliver Shandong's latest investment policies and industrial plans precisely to Hong Kong business circles — closing the information gap, attracting Hong Kong entrepreneurs to invest in Shandong's real economy, and deepening industrial integration.
about_north_card2_text: We build high-end research transformation channels, helping Hong Kong professors and experts land high-quality research outcomes (biomedicine, AI, new materials) in Shandong — attracting not only capital but also intellect, boosting Shandong's industrial upgrading with new quality productive forces.
about_north_card3_text: Integrating Qilu cultural resources, we attract Hong Kong youth to "root-seeking study tours" that strengthen national identity; we also build innovation & entrepreneurship service stations for Hong Kong and Macao youth, offering policy consultation and landing support.
about_north_card3_title: Cultural Roots, Dreams for the Future
about_north_mission: [Core Mission] Attracting Hong Kong capital, intellect and youth, empowering Shandong's transition to new growth drivers
about_north_title: Northbound: Channeling Hong Kong Capital into Shandong

about_partners_p: We are not only a platform, but a high-end resource consortium linked by AI. Through deep collaboration with authoritative institutions, we ensure the compliance, authority and execution efficiency of every service.
about_south_card1_text: Addressing the cross-border pain points of Shandong enterprises, we use AI to deeply analyze international trade regulations and tax policies, providing full-process intelligent guidance from qualification application to operational compliance — ensuring enterprises "go steadily and go far", and bringing quality Shandong products to Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and global markets.
about_south_card2_text: Working closely with InvestHK policies, we provide mainland entrepreneurs with one-stop concierge services covering Hong Kong identity application, children's education (from kindergarten to university) and family integration — helping entrepreneurs join Hong Kong mainstream society while fostering patriotic Hong Kong sentiment.
about_south_card2_title: Identity Planning, Family & Country in Harmony
about_south_card3_text: We guide Shandong entrepreneurs based in Hong Kong to leverage the city's capital advantages and reinvest in their hometown, forming a virtuous business cycle of "rooted in Hong Kong, contributing to the country, giving back to Shandong".
about_south_mission: [Core Mission] Helping Shandong enterprises "go global", echoing central policies benefiting Hong Kong, and strengthening patriotic Hong Kong forces
about_south_title: Southbound: Helping Shandong Enterprises Go Global
